review_rationale: This exact 16,496-byte merged server core catalog is byte-identical to PR #937 head. The PR951 baseline incorrectly listed optional mad4b/control-plane-test-route on mad4b-read and mad4b-chatgpt before registration; the reviewed PR937 source removes both unconditional entries and adds the route only after exact WordPress wp_has_ability and native MCP descriptor binding. This review is source-only; no Site Owner, signed Host release certificate, grant or deployment authority is inferred.
